beats.text: You have less than a day to live.
You're one of about twenty men on Blackbeard's ship. By next summer, almost every one of you will be dead or hanged.
Only two kinds of men walk away. Stay to the end and you'll know if you're one of them.
And the strangest part? Tonight, Blackbeard isn't worried at all.
It's the twenty-first of November, seventeen eighteen. A small sloop is anchored in a quiet inlet off North Carolina.
There's rum, there's laughing, there are guests on board, people from the little town of Bath nearby. Remember them, one of them matters later.
Someone asks the captain: does your wife know where you buried your money? One account says he laughed: Nobody but me and the devil knows where it is.
Spoiler: no treasure of his has ever been found. The ship's hold is full of cocoa and cotton.
